note: Nance County has no queryable zoning district service found. The county's Official Zoning Map (adopted by reference in the Nov 2023 zoning regulations) and Fullerton's zoning map are published only as PDF maps; Genoa's 2012 ordinance refers to an official district map it does not link. The county GIS viewers (nance.gisworkshop.com, nance.gworks.com) were unreachable and no zoning layer appeared in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches. Regrid carries standardized parcel zoning but is a commercial product, not an official queryable layer.
